notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial Update
notes.notes:
[h3]My latest project in the Demonheart world just got a major update![/h3]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dh_24_09_23]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] Chapter 6 is out![/h2]

The Cursed Trial is a murder mystery / romance in which Raze ("The Seer") has captured a group of humans for the entertainment of his demonic master. (Raze doesn't really have a master, he just made a deal with someone and is playing along.)

The main character, whose name you can change, can fall in love with two of her fellow captives.

[b]If you haven't joined in on the adventure yet, consider doing so now by wishlisting or purchasing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dh_24_09_23]The Cursed Trial[/url] - your interest and support help me develop these niche games![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27939525/6a36655bc032b44606be531d772aab390cc7f469.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demonheart: Hunters - Anniversary content update!
notes.notes:
It's been almost 4 years since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897930/Demonheart_Hunters/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=24_01_24]Demonheart: Hunters[/url] came out! I wanted to thank you all for your interest in my games and your support, so I was secretly preparing this content update. You can read the full list of changes in the announcement [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/897930/view/3948035142424262082]here[/url].

In the meantime, I'll continue working on the fourth chapter of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=24_01_24]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] ːheart_eyes_yetiː

notes.title: Progress Update - End of November 2023
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm here with a progress update on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=23_12_01]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url], which came out in early access.

I'm happy with the reactions the game has received so far, as well as the love certain characters are getting. ːhappy_yetiː

There is now fanart of the Cursed Trial characters.  ːsurprised_yetiː Some of it is in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2364560/images/]Artwork[/url] section in the Steam community, and more art has been posted on the Rolling Crown Discord or Tumblr, Twitter etc, if you search for it.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/f1cd77c8c327470d262484aa7a923ef4ce2cdd87.png[/img]

I have been working on the script for the next chapter. As of today, around 12.400 words are in-game for Chapter 4, with more in text documents, waiting to be edited and used. After I am done with the first version of the text, the game will still need testing, scene edits for the scenes that turn out to need it, and polish such as adding sound effects. There will be two new CGs, which are already finished. The estimate for the chapter's release is early February.

I have posted the planned timeline for releasing all the chapters on the store page and in the Steam discussions [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2364560/discussions/0/4035850170399796343/]here[/url] - it could change over time, but that is the general plan. With the holiday season ahead, I expected late December and early January to be a slower time for work, so that's why Chapter 4 is planned to come out in February, even though it feels like it could be finished sooner. ːdazed_yetiː

notes.title: Cursed Trial - Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/b7238acd9f3138009f0174eb5580a6a91ba2728b.jpg[/img]

While working on the third out of the seven chapters of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=23-10-20]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url], I went back to the first chapter (demo) and made some edits. There are a lot of small changes which you may or may not notice if you replay.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Rephrased many lines of narration and dialog.
[*] Changed some expressions and sprite positions. Changed Ran's expression on several occasions into less childish and more manly ones. ':)
[*] Added a few new choices and NPC lines - nothing crucial, but these changes will mess with old saves. Old alignment and relationship points will be preserved, but you may end up on the wrong line when you reload.
[*] Started silently tracking Janiya's approval. Old saves didn't track this, so it will be like your relationship with her was neutral. Which is not the worst it could be. ':)
[*] Changed some sound effects.
[/list]

[h1]The demo is available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=23-10-20]here[/url]! Don't forget to wishlist the Cursed Trial![/h1]

Meanwhile, the third chapter is nearly finished, and when it's polished, there's a possibility of Steam early access! Stay tuned for news about it, and thank you for following!

notes.title: Update + Cursed Trial Demo
notes.notes:
The updates brought by version 2.00+ are now included in the latest Mac OS build. Also, the Mac build is now signed and notarized by Apple.

We also fixed a few issues on all operating systems:
[list]
[*] Achievement Touchy Fingers should work again (when you click on the demonspawn's amulet in the main menu you should hear his voice.)
[*] The mouse cursor should no longer change to the default arrow at the edges of the screen.
[/list]
The updates introduced in v2.00, now included in the Mac OS build, were:
[list]
[*] The conversation UI can now be hidden by middle-clicking with the mouse, and restored on any click.
[*] Right-clicking closes menus, as is common in some visual novels.
[*] Added an in-game screen with achievements progress.
[*] Exploration mode now shows where the explorable objects are. (Also, its whole implementation had to change due to the engine change.)
[*] Clarified the anagram minigame message in English - that you need to drag the letters.
[*] Steam Overlay and screenshots should work without having to enable anything.
[*] Slightly restyled some parts of the UI. Increased font size.
[/list]
If the new version doesn't work for you for any reason, you can use Steam's Betas functionality to revert to version 1.65 (the branch name is v165.)

[h2]In other news, the demo for Demonheart: The Cursed Trial is coming to Steam soon![/h2]
It's scheduled to come out on June 20th.

Check out the game and add it to your wishlist if you haven't done so already:

notes.title: Huge Engine Update v2.00
notes.notes:
This update should upgrade the game engine to v2.00 for Windows 64-bit users.
MacOS and Linux updates are in preparation. We're trying to rule out any issues with the code changes first.

We switched the underlying game engine, so this is mostly a technical update, but it comes with a few UI additions as well.

I hope everything works as intended - If not, please post bug reports in discussions.

When your game updates to v2.00, you should get the following changes:
[list]
[*] While playing, the UI can now be hidden by middle-clicking with the mouse, and restored on any click.
[*] Right-clicking closes menus, as is common in some visual novels.
[*] Added an in-game screen with achievements progress.
[*] Exploration mode now shows where the explorable objects are. (Also, its whole implementation had to change due to the engine change.)
[*] Clarified the anagram minigame message in English - that you need to drag the letters.
[*] Steam Overlay and screenshots should work without having to enable anything.
[*] Slightly restyled some parts of the UI. Increased font size.
[/list]
Update: If you haven't seen the news about the upcoming Demonheart game, check it out here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dh2][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33404344/74e03e50e7669280534bb65cd424c74c6b24e105.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Jester / King Demo Update v1.06 - Voice Acting
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce an updated version of the Jester / King demo, now with voice acting!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33404344/34ea3e9fab9de90204481b1b16b8f67fdd71d2bb.jpg[/img]

Note: The game will no longer allow you to load saves from versions prior to v1.06. I rewrote parts of the demo and changed the way character names are revealed, which broke the old saves.

There is still a lot of testing and polishing left to do for the full game, but I hope I can get it done in the next couple of months.

In the meantime, I've started commissioning art for a new VN in the Demonheart world and opened a [url=https://www.patreon.com/rollingcrown]Patreon[/url] where you can check how it's going. If you like what I'm making, please consider supporting me.

notes.title: Update Notes v1.64
notes.notes:
After developing the mobile versions of Demonheart, I found and fixed some small bugs in the PC version, too:
* Fix for convo getting stuck after anagram.
* Fix for journal icon glowing when game attempts to give you a journal entry which you already have.

notes.title: Update v1.35 - Skip Option
notes.notes:
[*]A skip option will appear in the lower right corner of the conversation space. You can also activate it by pressing the arrow right key. Skip will fast forward through parts of the game you've already seen, until the next choice or new content.

[*]From now on when you play, the game will remember which parts you've already seen. It will also attempt to register content from your saves. Depending on how often you saved, you might have to replay some parts before they become skippable.

Initially I thought the skip function wouldn't do much because choices are everywhere, but it does help to save some time, and there [i]are[/i] some sequences of 10+ lines without choices. :)
